行程量、营收、时长分位数与平均车速。: Trips, passenger payments, duration quantiles, and average speed.
按服务类型统计每日行程，并用窗口函数计算 7 日移动平均。: Daily trips by service, with a seven-day moving average calculated using window functions.
每个(星期, 小时)时段的平均每小时上车量。: Average hourly pickups for each weekday and hour.
上车量 Top 15 区域、占比与客单价。: Top 15 pickup zones, trip shares, and average passenger payment.
出行最多的 20 条起终点组合，含中位时长与平均车速。: Top 20 origin–destination pairs with median duration and average speed.
行政区 → 行政区 的行程数（桑基图）。: Trip counts between boroughs, shown as a Sankey diagram.
黄车 / 绿车 / Uber / Lyft 每月行程量与份额。: Monthly trip volumes and shares for Yellow, Green, Uber, and Lyft.
JFK / LGA / EWR 进出机场行程按小时分布。: Hourly trip patterns to and from JFK, LGA, and EWR.
工作日 / 周末各小时平均车速，反映道路拥堵。: Hourly average speeds on weekdays and weekends as a congestion indicator.
按 1 英里分箱的行程距离分布（30 英里以上合并）。: Trip distances in one-mile bins, with trips over 30 miles grouped together.
各公司每英里/每分钟票价、小费率、司机分成、等车时间与拥堵费覆盖率。: Fares per mile/minute, tips, driver share, waits, and congestion-fee coverage by company.
HVFHV 各小时从叫车到上车的中位 / P90 等待时间。: Median and P90 request-to-pickup waits by hour for high-volume for-hire vehicles.
区域-小时上车量相对“同区域·同星期·同小时”留一法基线的 Z 分数，每个区域取: Zone/hour pickup Z scores against a leave-one-out baseline for the same zone, weekday, and hour. One peak per zone, up to three per day; associations with events require further evidence.
已完成行程不等于全部叫车需求；不能据此确认缺车或未满足需求。: Completed trips do not capture all requests and cannot establish driver shortages or unmet demand.
乘客支付金额不是平台营收或利润；缺少成本、取消率、接单率和在线司机数据。: Passenger payments are not platform revenue or profit. Costs, cancellations, acceptance rates, and available drivers are unknown.
结果描述历史关联，不证明天气、活动或政策的因果影响，也不是未来预测。: Results describe historical associations, not causal effects of weather, events, or policy, and are not forecasts.
市场份额仅指所选服务的已导入有效行程；清洗规则和原始数据完整性会影响结果。: Shares cover only retained trips in the selected services. Cleaning and source completeness affect results.
机会按日均行程绝对增量排序，不是利润排序；工作日/周末分开，未进一步控制节假日。: Opportunities are ranked by absolute daily trip growth, not profit. Weekdays and weekends are separated; holidays are not controlled.
三个月的部分服务缺文件、缺日期或行数不一致，暂停机会排名；请先补齐或检查数据。: Some service/month slices have missing files, missing dates, or inconsistent row counts. Opportunity ranking is paused until data is checked.
部分文件清洗排除比例超过 5%，请检查数据质量后再解释业务变化。: Some files exclude over 5% of source rows. Check quality before interpreting business changes.
三个月内最新月对比上月；按日历天归一化。区域×服务×工作日/周末×6小时时段；前: Compare the latest month with the previous month using calendar-day normalization. Group by zone, service, weekday/weekend, and six-hour band, with at least 100 trips in each comparison month. Exclude unknown zones and rank by absolute daily trip change, without significance testing. New, vanished, and small groups are excluded. Coverage checks detect missing dates but cannot prove source completeness.
